author: David Leisering
title: Donovan Walton goes deep in Sunday win over Athletics
desc: Donovan Walton went 1-for-3 with a three-run home run on Sunday as the Angels defeated the Athletics, 9-7.
impact: Walton took Athletics' starter Jack Perkins deep with two on and one out in the second to get the Angels on the scoreboard. It was Walton's third home run of the year with all three coming in his last six games. He is seeing more regular playing time as he's batting .522 (12-for-23) with three homers and 10 RBI over his last seven games. Overall, he's batting .343 with a .927 OPS in 70 at bats this season.

author: David Leisering
title: Denzer Guzman hits game-tying home run Sunday
desc: Denzer Guzman went 2-for-3 with two runs scored and a game-tying three-run homer in the eighth as the Angels defeated the Athletics, 9-7, on Sunday.
impact: Guzman has now gone deep in three consecutive games as he is beginning to showcase the power he displayed in the minors. His three-run homer on Sunday came off of Hogan Harris and tied the game at 7-7 with one out in the eighth inning. In 12 games since his call up, Guzman is batting .271 (13-for-48) with three home runs and 11 runs batted in. If he continues to play every day as the Angels' third baseman, he definitely is worth a flier in deeper and AL-only leagues.

author: David Leisering
title: Zach Neto hits go-ahead home run Sunday in win over A's
desc: Zach Neto went 1-for-5 with a two-run home run in Sunday's 9-7 victory over the Athletics.
impact: Neto was 0-for-4 with two strikeouts before belting a go-ahead two-run home run in the top of the ninth off of Elvis Alvarado to propel the Angels to the win. It was Neto's 17th home run of the season and his seventh in his last 15 games. The shortstop is batting just .225 on the season but half of his 68 hits (15 doubles, two triples, 17 home runs) have gone for extra bases. He has also added 11 stolen bases in 76 games this year.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Backhus (elbow) to be activated Monday
desc: The Phillies are activating Kyle Backhus from the injured list on Monday.
impact: The Phillies optioned Max Lazar to Triple-A as the corresponding move.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Max Lazar optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Phillies are optioning Max Lazar to Triple-A.
impact: Lazar will head back to Triple-A to make room for Kyle Backhus getting activated.

author: David Leisering
title: Jake Mangum records three hits in Sunday victory
desc: Jake Mangum went 3-for-4 with a run scored and an RBI on Sunday as the Pirates hung on for an 8-6 win over the Rockies.
impact: Mangum had two singles and a double for his third three-hit performance of the month. The speedy outfielder is batting .375 (21-for-56) with five doubles, four RBI, and five steals in 17 games this month. Overall, Mangum is slashing .306/.353/.369 with one home run, 13 RBI, and 13 stolen bases in 58 games this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Bryse Wilson designated for assignment
desc: The Phillies are designating Bryse Wilson for assignment.
impact: Wilson loses his spot on the Phillies 40-man roster. He will head to waivers as a result.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Julian Garcia to be called up by Reds
desc: The Reds are calling up RHP Julian Garcia.
impact: Garcia will be making his MLB debut when he gets into a game. He has posted a 3.03 ERA in Triple-A this season.

author: David Leisering
title: Nick Gonzales goes deep in win over Rockies on Sunday
desc: Nick Gonzales went 2-for-4 with two runs scored and a two-run home run on Sunday as the Pirates defeated the Rockies, 8-6.
impact: Gonzales belted his third home run of the season in the third off of Colorado starter, Michael Lorenzen. He also singled and scored in the sixth for his third two-hit effort in his last seven games. Gonzales is batting .293 with three home runs and 35 runs batted in across 72 games this season.

author: David Leisering
title: Bryan Reynolds homers, drives in three on Sunday
desc: Bryan Reynolds went 2-for-5 with two runs scored and a three-run home run on Sunday, lifting the Pirates to an 8-6 win over the Rockies.
impact: Reynolds had a double off of Michael Lorenzen to lead off the fourth and then scored on a home run by Nick Gonzales. Then, in the seventh, Reynolds blasted a three-run shot off of Juan Mejia - his 11th homer of the year - which extended the Pittsburgh lead to 8-1. Reynolds is one of the hottest hitters in the game right now as he extended his hitting streak to 12 consecutive games during which he is hitting .404 (19-for-47) with 10 runs scored, five doubles, five home runs, and 12 RBI. Overall, the veteran is batting .284 with an .881 OPS through 78 games this season. He ranks in the top ten in the National League in runs scored (52), doubles (18), RBI (51), walks (49), and on-base percentage (.400).

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Nick Martinez delivers quality start Sunday
desc: Nick Martinez gave up three runs on four hits and three walks while striking out five over six innings in Sunday's 4-3 win over the Washington Nationals.
impact: Martinez has now allowed at least three runs in four consecutive starts. After entering June with a 1.62 ERA, he has seen his numbers climb to a 2.73 ERA overall and a 6.04 ERA in June. His next scheduled outing is on Friday against the Arizona Diamondbacks.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ryan Vilade goes yard Sunday
desc: Ryan Vilade went 1-for-4 with a solo home run in Sunday's 4-3 win over the Washington Nationals.
impact: Vilade launched a 436-foot home run to center field off Gus Varland in the sixth inning. He has homered in two of his last four games and is slugging an impressive .590 across 39 at-bats in June.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Jonny DeLuca goes deep Sunday
desc: Jonny DeLuca went 2-for-4 with one home run, a double, one run scored and two RBI in Sunday's 4-3 win over the Washington Nationals.
impact: DeLuca crushed a 396-foot home run in the seventh inning to give the Tampa Bay Rays the lead. Activated from the injured list on Friday, he has made an immediate impact by going 3-for-8 with two home runs, a double, two runs scored, three RBI and a stolen base. DeLuca is worth considering in deeper fantasy leagues, as he is expected to see regular playing time in the outfield.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Chandler Simpson logs stolen base Sunday
desc: Chandler Simpson went 1-for-4 with a stolen base in Sunday's 4-3 win over the Washington Nationals.
impact: Simpson has struggled in June, slashing .149/.184/.149, but bounced back during the weekend series against the Nationals by going 4-for-12 with an RBI and two stolen bases. He'll look to build on that performance in a four-game series against the Kansas City Royals beginning Monday, where his speed could once again provide value for fantasy managers.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Kevin Kelly records save Sunday
desc: Kevin Kelly pitched a scoreless ninth inning in Sunday's 4-3 win over the Washington Nationals to earn his third save of the season.
impact: Kelly received the save opportunity after Bryan Baker was called upon to face the top of the Nationals' order in the eighth inning. Kelly allowed one single and struck out two in a scoreless ninth. He owns a 2.60 ERA and 0.92 WHIP this season and could continue to see save chances whenever Baker is used earlier in games or is unavailable.
